title: Toys — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Toys Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

productName.title: Product Name
productName.description: Commercial name or trade designation of the toy (our product convenience field — not directly mandated by Regulation (EU) 2025/2509; point (e) requires identification allowing traceability, not a commercial name).
productName.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part I(e): identification of the toy allowing traceability. Applies from 1 August 2030 (Art. 59); like the battery and detergent templates, the data of an adopted, dated passport act is required ahead of that date.

commodityCode.title: Commodity Code (TARIC)
commodityCode.description: Where applicable, the Combined Nomenclature commodity code under which the toy is classified when the passport is created (Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 Annex VI Part I(f)).
commodityCode.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part I(f), where applicable. Applies from 1 August 2030 (Art. 59); like the battery and detergent templates, the data of an adopted, dated passport act is required ahead of that date.

modelNumber.title: Type / Batch / Serial / Model Number
modelNumber.description: A type, batch, serial or model number or other element allowing the identification of the toy (Art. 7(5) of Regulation (EU) 2025/2509), contributing to the object of the passport per Annex VI Part I(e).

passportServiceProvider.title: Passport Service Provider
passportServiceProvider.description: Reference of the digital product passport service provider hosting the back-up copy of the passport (Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 Annex VI Part I(n)).

communicationChannel.title: Safety Complaint Channel
communicationChannel.description: The publicly available channel (telephone number, electronic address or website section) through which consumers can report safety complaints and accidents to the manufacturer (Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 Art. 7(12), Annex VI Part I(m)).

responsibleEconomicOperator.title: Responsible Economic Operator (EU)
responsibleEconomicOperator.description: Name, address and unique operator identifier of the economic operator responsible in the EU for the tasks of Article 4 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 (the EU manufacturer, importer, authorised representative or fulfilment service provider).

batchLotNumber.title: Batch / Serial Number
batchLotNumber.description: Batch or serial number for product traceability and recall purposes
batchLotNumber.x-citationNote: A batch number is one identifying element among several (Art. 7(5)); modelNumber carries the passport duty.

gtin.title: GTIN / Barcode
gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number (EAN/UPC barcode) for the product

productImageUrl.title: Product Image
productImageUrl.description: URL to the main product image

ceMarking.title: CE Marking
ceMarking.description: Whether the toy bears the CE marking, confirming conformity with EU toy safety requirements

allergenicFragrances.title: Allergenic Fragrances
allergenicFragrances.description: Allergenic fragrances present in the toy that are subject to the labelling requirements of Part B, point 1, of the Appendix to Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 (Annex VI Part I(l)).
allergenicFragrances.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part I(l): only fragrances present and subject to the Annex II Appendix Part B labelling, so a toy with none has an empty list. Applies from 1 August 2030 (Art. 59); like the battery and detergent templates, the data of an adopted, dated passport act is required ahead of that date.

notifiedBodyCertificateReference.title: Notified Body Certificate Reference
notifiedBodyCertificateReference.description: Where a notified body took part in the conformity assessment, the reference of the certificate it issued (Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 Annex VI Part I(j)).
notifiedBodyCertificateReference.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part I(j), where applicable; the body's name and number are in notifiedBody. Applies from 1 August 2030 (Art. 59); like the battery and detergent templates, the data of an adopted, dated passport act is required ahead of that date.

harmonisedStandardsReferences.title: Harmonised Standards Used
harmonisedStandardsReferences.description: References to the harmonised standards used, or to the common specifications against which conformity is declared (Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 Annex VI Part I(i)).

replacesDeclarationOfConformity.title: Replaces EU Declarations of Conformity
replacesDeclarationOfConformity.description: Where applicable, the other Union acts (such as Directive 2014/53/EU or 2011/65/EU) whose EU declaration of conformity this passport replaces (Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 Annex VI Part I(h)).
replacesDeclarationOfConformity.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part I(h), where applicable. Applies from 1 August 2030 (Art. 59); like the battery and detergent templates, the data of an adopted, dated passport act is required ahead of that date.

unionLawReferences.title: Union Law Complied With
unionLawReferences.description: References to every piece of Union law the toy complies with (Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 Annex VI Part I(g)).

complianceDemonstrated.title: Compliance Demonstrated
complianceDemonstrated.description: The manufacturer's statement that compliance of the toy with Regulation (EU) 2025/2509, and in particular the essential safety requirements, has been demonstrated (Art. 19(2)(b)).

issuedUnderSoleResponsibility.title: Issued Under Manufacturer's Sole Responsibility
issuedUnderSoleResponsibility.description: The manufacturer's statement that this passport is issued under its sole responsibility (Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 Annex VI Part I(d)).

declarationOfConformityUrl.title: EU Declaration of Conformity
declarationOfConformityUrl.description: URL to the EU Declaration of Conformity document per Toy Safety Directive
declarationOfConformityUrl.x-citationNote: Under Reg (EU) 2025/2509 the passport replaces the declaration of conformity; under the Directive, until 31 July 2030, the declaration is drawn up but no law requires a URL.

intendedAgeGroup.title: Intended Age Group
intendedAgeGroup.description: Age range the toy is designed and intended for, as required by the Toy Safety Directive
intendedAgeGroup.x-citationNote: A labelled user limitation where safe use needs it; the passport may carry warnings (Annex VI Part II) but need not.

safetyWarnings.title: Safety Warnings
safetyWarnings.description: Mandatory safety warnings per Toy Safety Directive Annex V (e.g. choking hazard, not for under 36 months)
safetyWarnings.x-citationNote: Warnings are marked on the toy, label or packaging; the passport may carry them (Annex VI Part II) but need not.

en71TestResults.title: EN 71 Test Results
en71TestResults.description: Results of EN 71 safety testing: EN 71-1 (mechanical/physical), EN 71-2 (flammability), EN 71-3 (migration of elements)
en71TestResults.x-citationNote: Test reports belong in the technical documentation; the passport references the standards used (Annex VI Part I(i)), not results.

notifiedBody.title: Notified Body
notifiedBody.description: Where applicable, name and number of the notified body that intervened in the conformity assessment procedure and issued a certificate, as well as the reference to the certificate (Annex VI Part I(j) of Regulation (EU) 2025/2509).
notifiedBody.x-citationNote: Annex VI Part I(j): where applicable, name and number of the notified body that has intervened in the conformity assessment procedure and issued a certificate, as well as the reference to the certificate. Conditional — only where a notified body is involved (EC type-examination or other third-party conformity assessment procedure). Applies from 1 August 2030 (Art. 59).

primaryMaterials.title: Primary Materials
primaryMaterials.description: List of primary materials used in the toy (e.g. ABS plastic, wood, cotton fabric, metal)
primaryMaterials.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — and none is scheduled (toys are not in the ESPR working plan COM(2025) 187); the toy passport under Reg. (EU) 2025/2509 Annex VI Part I does not list this datum — so this field is optional. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

svhcPresent.title: SVHC Presence
svhcPresent.description: Whether the toy contains Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) above 0.1% w/w per REACH Article 33
svhcPresent.x-citationNote: REACH Art. 33(1) is owed to the recipient when a Candidate List substance is above 0,1 % w/w; not passport data.

substancesOfConcern.title: Substances of Concern
substancesOfConcern.description: Detailed list of substances of concern present in the toy, including CAS numbers, concentrations, and locations (SCIP-level detail)

concentrationPercent.description: % by mass of the article or mixture

substancesOfConcern.x-citationNote: REACH Art. 33 requires communication to business recipients, and to consumers ON REQUEST within 45 days, for candidate-list substances above 0.1% w/w, with the substance NAME as the minimum content. Toy-specific chemical limits are separately enforced as composition restrictions rather than disclosure duties.

phthalateCompliant.title: Phthalate Compliance
phthalateCompliant.description: Confirms that restricted phthalates (DEHP, DBP, BBP, DINP, DIDP, DNOP) are each below 0.1% in plasticised material per REACH Annex XVII Entry 51

heavyMetalMigration.title: Heavy Metal Migration (EN 71-3)
heavyMetalMigration.description: EN 71-3 test results for migration of 19 elements (antimony, arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury, selenium, etc.) across 3 material categories

recycledContentPercentage.title: Recycled Content (%)
recycledContentPercentage.description: Percentage of recycled material by weight in the toy product
recycledContentPercentage.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. recyclabilityAssessment.title: Recyclability Assessment
recyclabilityAssessment.description: Assessment of how easily the toy can be recycled at end of life
recyclabilityAssessment.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. packagingMaterial.title: Packaging Material
packagingMaterial.description: Primary material used in product packaging
packagingMaterial.x-citationNote: The packaging of a toy is governed by PPWR, which creates no packaging passport: its Art. 12 material-composition duty is a harmonised PICTOGRAM label whose format awaits an implementing act. Nothing requires declaring the packaging material as toy product data.

carbonFootprint.title: Carbon Footprint
carbonFootprint.description: Total carbon footprint of the toy product in kg CO2 equivalent (cradle-to-gate or cradle-to-grave)
carbonFootprint.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. careInstructions.description: Instructions for cleaning, maintenance, and safe use of the toy
careInstructions.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. expectedLifespan.description: Expected useful lifespan of the toy under normal use conditions

disposalInstructions.title: Disposal / Recycling Instructions
disposalInstructions.description: Instructions for proper disposal or recycling of the toy at end of life, including any hazardous components (batteries, electronics)
disposalInstructions.x-citationNote: GPSR requires the information needed for safe use to accompany the product. Disposal guidance for a toy is not separately mandated; where the toy contains batteries or electronics, the separate-collection marking duties of those regimes apply instead.

countryOfManufacture.title: Country of Manufacture
countryOfManufacture.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the toy was manufactured

ceMarkingStatus.title: CE Marking Status
ceMarkingStatus.description: Whether the product bears CE marking and its validity
ceMarkingStatus.x-citationNote: The law knows only whether the CE marking is borne; this status duplicates ceMarking, which carries the passport duty.
